Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! Afghanistan take the ODI series. Hashmatullah Shahidi collects the trophy. It is now time for the T20I. The first match will be on the 14th of this month. Join us at 5.30 pm IST (12 pm GMT) for the coverage. Cheers!

Hashmatullah Shahidi says they are happy with the performance and will learn from this game. Adds Bangladesh put them under pressure from the start. Reckons they are ready for the T20I series. Ends by thanking the crowd for their incredible support.

Litton Das says it was important to win before switching to T20I series. Adds Shoriful Islam and Taskin Ahmed started really well and so did the spinners. Reckons there was no pressure to chase it down quickly so it helped them.
Fazalhaq Farooqi wins the Player of the Series award.
Shoriful Islam wins the Player of the Match.
...Presentation next...

Afghanistan needed a miracle to win here. Fazalhaq Farooqi tried his best by taking two quick wickets but there were short of runs dearly. Only Azmatullah Omarzai clicked with the bat which was clearly not enough. Afghanistan win the series but would have loved to wrap the series with a better performance.

A dominating performance by Bangladesh and they have avoided the whitewash on the back of good performance. The bowlers did a great job to restrict Afghanistan to such a score. The likes of Shoriful Islam, Taskin Ahmed and the spinners did well to keep it neat and clean. Discipline and wickets early on was the key for Bangladesh in this match.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point and into the fence. THAT IS THE WINNING RUNS! BANGLADESH WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
